name: Küstenweg
format: Uint16 little-endian, decimetres, sea = 0, row 0 = north, column 0 = west; pixel (c,r) centre = (grid_west_m+(c+0.5)*pixel_m, grid_north_m-(r+0.5)*pixel_m)
ele_note: DEM (kueste60.bin) sampled bilinearly on the OSM road line, bridge/tunnel spans linearly interpolated, smoothed (2x moving average +-100 m)
sea_side_note: -1 = sea on the left, 1 = sea on the right, 0 = no sea within 800 m (or both sides, e.g. on bridges); relative to riding direction
